key_insight: EAPO improves LLM reasoning by reusing past RL experience as a policy-adaptive action prior rather than as fixed trajectories.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more sample-efficient RLVR training strategy that can reduce rollout cost while better matching the model’s evolving policy during training.
method: Uses a prior RL-optimized policy as an action-level experience prior.
Injects experience only at critical decision points during rollout.
Adds adapted importance sampling to stabilize and de-bias learning from augmented trajectories.
evidence_signal: The method was evaluated on Qwen-2.5-math 7B and Qwen-3-8B across five benchmarks, where it consistently outperformed state-of-the-art RLVR methods.
watch_item: Because experience is injected selectively and corrected with importance sampling, performance may depend on how well the prior policy matches the current model and on careful tuning of the sampling weights.
paper_title: Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
